honest_note: B warm-starts entirely off the SHARED store root: same relative keys + mtime-preserving copy match A's manifest, so B's cold index is a no-op AND its blob puts never run. Costs stated: A pays a per-object fsync for CAS publication (dual-write makes A's cold ingest slower than a no-CAS run); same-machine shared root only — the artifact-import variant (docs/design/team-shared-warm-store.md) is designed, not built.
